x-openregister._seedDataNote: Seed objects MOVED to lib/Settings/profiles/*.json (OpenSpec change seed-profiles). A register.d fragment declares SCHEMAS ONLY, so installing this app plants zero objects. The examples that used to live here are now part of an example set an operator picks in the first-time setup wizard, which is the only thing that imports them.

MondelingeVraag.title: MondelingeVraag
MondelingeVraag.description: An oral question (mondelinge vraag) for the vragenuur: a raadslid submits a question to a portefeuillehouder before a per-body configurable deadline (VragenuurConfiguratie), the chair/griffier admits or rejects it, admitted questions are scheduled into the vragenuur AgendaItem of the target meeting, and the spoken answer is recorded with optional follow-ups, a Toezegging in the sibling toezeggingen register (vervolgToezegging) or a follow-up written question (vervolgSchriftelijkeVraag). Implements the vragenrecht side of Gemeentewet art. 155 / the local Reglement van Orde; complements SchriftelijkeVraag (fractievoorzitter-fractie-koppeling) with bidirectional escalation via bronSchriftelijkeVraag. AUTHORITY (design D3): raadsleden create; only griffie/chair transition admission, scheduling and answering, enforced by OR RBAC groups plus per-object guards on the imperative OralQuestionService action endpoints (not declared in this fragment; the read/write RBAC group dialect is not established in decidesk's register fragments today, so authority is documented here and carried by the action endpoints). NUMBERING + DEADLINE (design D3): vraagNummer (MV-{jaar}-{volgnummer}, per body per year) and the submission deadline (targetMeeting.start − indieningstermijnUren, griffier override) are computed imperatively by OralQuestionService, sequence allocation and cross-object datetime comparison are not expressible as a dialect. PUBLICATION (design D4): the live object is NEVER public (rejection reasons and pre-decision context must not publish raw); public exposure runs exclusively through the derived allow-list PublicationPayload (public-publication), so this schema declares no public read predicate.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031, REQ-VRI-002). Canonical dialect verbatim from the Toezegging/Raadsinformatiebrief schemas (keyword 'initial', never 'initialState'/'states'-only/'default'). ingediend → toegelaten | afgewezen; toegelaten → ingepland; ingepland → beantwoord | niet-behandeld; niet-behandeld → ingepland (re-scheduled to a later vragenuur); ingediend | toegelaten | ingepland | niet-behandeld → ingetrokken. beantwoord, afgewezen and ingetrokken terminal. The admission decision (toegelaten/afgewezen) is recorded by chair/griffier; afwijzingsReden is required on afgewezen (save-time enforcement, not schema 'required', since it is conditional). No app-side state machine.

mvIngediend._note: Submission confirmation to the indiener and the griffie group (REQ-VRI-007). Declarative created-trigger (ADR-031); gate-18 hard-fails imperative dispatch. Recipients resolve via object-acl (read) + the decidesk-members group, never kind:field on the indiener Person reference (per decidesk-notifications recipient rules — no recipient kind targets a Person reference directly).

mvToegelaten._note: Admission notification to the indiener and portefeuillehouder (REQ-VRI-007). updated-trigger filtered on lifecycle toegelaten.

mvAfgewezen._note: Rejection notification to the indiener including the afwijzingsReden (REQ-VRI-007). updated-trigger filtered on lifecycle afgewezen.

mvIngepland._note: Scheduling notification to the indiener and portefeuillehouder (REQ-VRI-007). updated-trigger filtered on lifecycle ingepland; the target meeting date travels via the object's targetMeeting reference.

subject.nl: Mondelinge vraag ingepland voor het vragenuur: {{vraagNummer}} — {{onderwerp}}
subject.en: Oral question scheduled for the question hour: {{vraagNummer}} — {{onderwerp}}

questionNumber.title: Question number
questionNumber.description: Human-readable question number in the format MV-{jaar}-{volgnummer} (schema-validated by pattern), mirroring the SV-{jaar}-{volgnummer} pattern. Auto-assigned by OralQuestionService at submission (sequence per governance body per year: imperative, design D3); always present at save time. Uniqueness is a review/validation concern (OR has no cross-object unique constraint) and the index sorts by number so duplicates are visible.

submitter.title: Submitter
submitter.description: Reference to the raadslid (Person) submitting the question (schema:Question author). Required.

politicalGroup.title: Fraction
politicalGroup.description: Reference to the submitter's Fractie (fractievoorzitter-fractie-koppeling: hard depends_on, that change owns the schema). Required. Seeded as a nil-UUID placeholder until that change lands (design D6). Declared as a PLAIN STRING, not format:uuid + $ref: the Fractie schema does not exist in this register yet, so a $ref to it is a dangling target (ADR-062 rule f) while dropping the $ref but keeping format:uuid is a relation-shaped property with no $ref (rule 7), the pair is unsatisfiable until that change lands. Restore format:uuid + $ref: Fractie in the same commit that introduces the schema.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: Subject of the oral question. Required; max 200 characters.

rationale.title: Motivation
rationale.description: Motivation / body of the oral question (rich text). Required.

portfolioHolder.title: Portefeuillehouder
portfolioHolder.description: Reference to the addressed college member (Person) the question is put to. Required. A public officeholder.

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody (council) the question belongs to. Required. Drives the per-body vrageNummer sequence and the VragenuurConfiguratie lookup.

targetMeeting.title: Target meeting
targetMeeting.description: Reference to the Meeting whose vragenuur the question targets. Required at submission. The submission deadline is computed as targetMeeting.start − VragenuurConfiguratie.indieningstermijnUren (imperative, design D3).

questionHourAgendaItem.title: Question-hour agenda item
questionHourAgendaItem.description: Reference to the vragenuur AgendaItem of the target meeting the question is scheduled into. An ordinary agenda item managed by agenda-item-crud; set at scheduling together with volgorde when the lifecycle moves to ingepland. Optional until scheduled.

sortOrder.title: Order
sortOrder.description: Order of the question within the vragenuur agenda item. Set at scheduling. Optional.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Question status (declared in x-openregister-lifecycle, ADR-031): ingediend → toegelaten | afgewezen; toegelaten → ingepland; ingepland → beantwoord | niet-behandeld; niet-behandeld → ingepland; ingetrokken reachable from ingediend/toegelaten/ingepland/niet-behandeld. beantwoord, afgewezen and ingetrokken are terminal. afwijzingsReden is required when afgewezen; antwoordSamenvatting is required when beantwoord (both save-time enforced).

rejectionReason.title: Rejection reason
rejectionReason.description: Reason the question was rejected (chair/griffier). Required when the lifecycle is afgewezen: a conditional-required rule enforced at save time, NOT in the schema 'required' array (no if/then dialect is used). Visible to the indiener.
rejectionReason.example: Betreft een individuele casus, geen algemeen belang

answerSummary.title: Answer summary
answerSummary.description: Summary of the spoken answer (rich text; schema:Answer text / acceptedAnswer). Required at the transition to beantwoord (save-time enforced). The full spoken answer is not transcribed here.

answeredBy.title: Answered by
answeredBy.description: Reference to the college member (Person) who gave the spoken answer. Set at the transition to beantwoord. Optional.

followUpCommitment.title: Follow-up commitment
followUpCommitment.description: Optional reference to a Toezegging registered in the sibling toezeggingen register (toezeggingen-ingekomen-stukken) when a commitment is made during the answer. Afdoening and lifecycle live EXCLUSIVELY on that Toezegging (design D5); this register creates no execution-update log. Nullable/soft: degrades to a plain link if that change is delayed.

followUpWrittenQuestion.title: Follow-up written question
followUpWrittenQuestion.description: Optional reference to a follow-up SchriftelijkeVraag (fractievoorzitter-fractie-koppeling) created from a niet-behandeld or beantwoord oral question. Its answering workflow stays in that change. Declared as a PLAIN STRING: see the note on MondelingeVraag.politicalGroup: the SchriftelijkeVraag schema does not exist in this register yet. Restore format:uuid + $ref in the commit that introduces it.

sourceWrittenQuestion.title: Source written question
sourceWrittenQuestion.description: Declared as a PLAIN STRING: see the note on MondelingeVraag.politicalGroup: the SchriftelijkeVraag schema does not exist in this register yet. Restore format:uuid + $ref in the commit that introduces it. Optional reference to the SchriftelijkeVraag this oral question escalates from (fractievoorzitter-fractie-koppeling). Set on written → oral escalation; when the oral question reaches beantwoord, OralQuestionService sets the linked SV to 'vervallen-door-mondelinge-beantwoording' via a PUT-semantic save carrying all other SV fields forward (design D6). No field mirroring or shared lifecycle.

Interpellatieverzoek.title: Interpellatieverzoek
Interpellatieverzoek.description: An interpellation request (interpellatieverzoek): a raadslid requests to interpellate a portefeuillehouder on a subject outside the order of the day (Gemeentewet art. 155 / local Reglement van Orde), collects support signatures (steunbetuigingen) against a per-body configurable threshold (VragenuurConfiguratie), the council decides on admission (verlof), and an admitted interpellation is scheduled as its OWN AgendaItem (never merged into the vragenuur item) and its treatment recorded. Explicitly deferred to this change by motie-amendement-administratie; motie van wantrouwen is out of scope. AUTHORITY (design D3): raadsleden create and record support; only griffie transitions the council's admission decision, scheduling and treatment. OR RBAC plus per-object guards on the imperative action endpoints (RBAC group dialect not declared in this fragment; see MondelingeVraag note). NUMBERING (design D3): verzoekNummer (INT-{jaar}-{volgnummer}, per body per year) is allocated imperatively by OralQuestionService. THRESHOLD (design D3): the support status ('N of M required', ceil rounding) is a client-side computed display from VragenuurConfiguratie and the body's member count, it INFORMS, never gates, the council's decision. PUBLICATION (design D4): the live object is NEVER public; public exposure runs through the derived allow-list PublicationPayload carrying the support COUNT only (never the individual supporter list, same totals-never-voters discipline as vote publication), so this schema declares no public read predicate.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031, REQ-VRI-010). Canonical dialect (keyword 'initial', never 'initialState'/'states'-only/'default'). ingediend → toegelaten | afgewezen (the council's admission decision); toegelaten → geagendeerd (scheduled as its own agenda item); geagendeerd → behandeld; ingediend | toegelaten | geagendeerd → ingetrokken. behandeld, afgewezen and ingetrokken terminal. Rejection carries afwijzingsReden; admission and rejection record raadsbesluitDatum (save-time enforced). No app-side state machine.

intIngediend._note: Submission confirmation to the verzoeker and the griffie group (REQ-VRI-014). Declarative created-trigger (ADR-031); gate-18 hard-fails imperative dispatch. Recipients via object-acl (read) + decidesk-members group, never kind:field on the verzoeker Person reference.

intToegelaten._note: Admission-decision notification to the verzoeker and portefeuillehouder (REQ-VRI-014). updated-trigger filtered on lifecycle toegelaten.

intAfgewezen._note: Rejection notification to the verzoeker including the afwijzingsReden (REQ-VRI-014). updated-trigger filtered on lifecycle afgewezen.

intGeagendeerd._note: Scheduling notification to the verzoeker and portefeuillehouder (REQ-VRI-014). updated-trigger filtered on lifecycle geagendeerd.

requestNumber.title: Request number
requestNumber.description: Human-readable request number in the format INT-{jaar}-{volgnummer} (schema-validated by pattern), same per-body-per-year sequencing as MV/SV numbers. Auto-assigned by OralQuestionService at submission (imperative, design D3); always present at save time.

requester.title: Requester
requester.description: Reference to the raadslid (Person) requesting the interpellation (schema:AskAction agent). Required.

politicalGroup.title: Fraction
politicalGroup.description: Reference to the requester's Fractie (fractievoorzitter-fractie-koppeling: hard depends_on). Required. Seeded as a nil-UUID placeholder until that change lands (design D6). Declared as a PLAIN STRING: see the note on MondelingeVraag.politicalGroup: the Fractie schema does not exist in this register yet. Restore format:uuid + $ref: Fractie in the commit that introduces it.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: Subject of the interpellation. Required; max 200 characters.

questions.title: Questions
questions.description: The questions to be put during the interpellation (rich text). Required.
questions.example: 1. Sinds wanneer was het college bekend met…

rationale.title: Motivation
rationale.description: Motivation for the interpellation (rich text). Optional.

portfolioHolder.title: Portefeuillehouder
portfolioHolder.description: Reference to the addressed college member (Person). Required. A public officeholder.

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody (council). Required. Drives the per-body verzoekNummer sequence and the VragenuurConfiguratie threshold lookup.

steunbetuigingen.title: Supporters
steunbetuigingen.description: Support signatures: an array of raadslid (Person) references, added while the request is ingediend. The display threshold status ('N of M required', ceil rounding) is computed client-side from VragenuurConfiguratie and the body's member count and INFORMS, never gates, the council's decision. On publication only the COUNT is exposed, never the individual references (design D4).

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Request status (declared in x-openregister-lifecycle, ADR-031): ingediend → toegelaten | afgewezen; toegelaten → geagendeerd; geagendeerd → behandeld; ingetrokken reachable from ingediend/toegelaten/geagendeerd. behandeld, afgewezen and ingetrokken are terminal. afwijzingsReden required when afgewezen; behandelingVerslag required when behandeld (both save-time enforced).

councilResolutionDate.title: Council decision date
councilResolutionDate.description: Date of the council's admission decision (verlof): recorded on toegelaten and afgewezen. Optional until decided.

rejectionReason.title: Rejection reason
rejectionReason.description: Reason the council rejected the request. Required when the lifecycle is afgewezen: a conditional-required rule enforced at save time, NOT in the schema 'required' array.

behandeldIn.title: Treated in
behandeldIn.description: Reference to the Meeting in which the interpellation was scheduled/treated. Set at scheduling (geagendeerd). Optional until scheduled.

agendaItem.title: Agenda item
agendaItem.description: Reference to the interpellation's OWN AgendaItem (created via agenda-item-crud: a separate item, never merged into the vragenuur item). Set at scheduling (geagendeerd). Optional until scheduled.

handlingMinutes.title: Treatment record
handlingMinutes.description: Record of the interpellation debate and the portefeuillehouder's answers (rich text). Required at the transition to behandeld (save-time enforced). May reference follow-up instruments (moties/toezeggingen) which live in their own registers: never duplicated here.

VragenuurConfiguratie.title: VragenuurConfiguratie
VragenuurConfiguratie.description: Per-governance-body vragenuur/interpellatie settings: at most one object per body, carrying the oral-question submission deadline (indieningstermijnUren) and the interpellation support threshold (interpellatieSteunDrempelType/-Waarde per Reglement van Orde). Modelled as its own schema rather than properties on GovernanceBody (design D2) so this change stays ADDED-only, does not race sibling changes touching GovernanceBody, and a body with no vragenuur simply has no configuratie object (threshold display degrades gracefully). Internal configuration: never published.

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody this configuration applies to (schema:StructuredValue). Required. At most one VragenuurConfiguratie per body: uniqueness is a review/validation concern (OR has no cross-object unique constraint).

submissionPeriodHours.title: Submission deadline (hours)
submissionPeriodHours.description: Number of hours before the target meeting's start by which oral questions must be submitted (Reglement van Orde). Default 24. Used by OralQuestionService to compute the deadline as targetMeeting.start − indieningstermijnUren; the griffier may override a late submission explicitly.

interpellationSupportThresholdType.title: Support threshold type
interpellationSupportThresholdType.description: How the interpellation support threshold is expressed: 'breukdeel' (a fraction of the body's members, e.g. 0.2 = 1/5 per Reglement van Orde) or 'aantal' (an absolute number of supporters). Combined with interpellatieSteunDrempelWaarde. Informative only.

interpellationSupportThresholdValue.title: Support threshold value
interpellationSupportThresholdValue.description: The threshold value: a fraction (e.g. 0.2 for 1/5 of members) when interpellatieSteunDrempelType is 'breukdeel', or an absolute count when 'aantal'. When applied as a breukdeel of the member count the required number is rounded UP (ceil): documented here so the rule travels with the schema (design risk: threshold rounding disputes).
